list: The official 55 trophies, checked 19 November 2026 against the PS5 list as reported by Exophase and cross-checked on GTABase, Output Lag and Press Start. 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; 0 online.

exophase.name: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list (via Techtroduce report, 18 Nov 2026)
exophase.verifies: The 55-trophy count, the Platinum name and the 100% completion Gold.

gtabase.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox)
gtabase.verifies: Every trophy name, description, grade and Gamerscore; counts (250 stunts, 42 shooting challenges, 14 drone locations, 18 meditations, 8 vaults, 39 operations, 9 gangs); the 100% checklist; which methods are still unconfirmed.

outputlag.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
outputlag.verifies: Every trophy name, description and grade; the Chapter 1 balcony meditation risk; the time-sensitive Yago race; the five trophies with no confirmed method.

pressstart.name: Press Start — Here’s The Full Trophy/Achievement List For Grand Theft Auto 6 (18 Nov 2026)
pressstart.verifies: The full 55 names and descriptions as published at launch.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Plan the run around A Long Road: the 100% checklist is the last big gate, so treat every other trophy as a step toward it and leave the long grinds for after the story.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies.
The Platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and finish it; the trophy pops at the end. Nothing to prepare — it is the game's first story trophy and cannot be missed.
steps: Start Chapter 1 and play Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy can pop when Chapter 2 begins rather than on the last cutscene, so keep playing into the next chapter's first mission if it has not appeared yet.
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 missions.
Play the first mission of Chapter 2 if the trophy has not popped yet.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City, so do not worry if it does not pop on the final Chapter 2 cutscene.
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 missions.
Play Welcome to Vice City at the start of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The trophy arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so keep playing past the chapter boundary.
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 missions.
Play Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It is an unmissable story trophy that pops as the story moves into the final chapter.
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 missions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you start it, keep an untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay — then free roam continues after the credits for everything still left on the list.
steps: Make a manual save just before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. Story trophies cannot be missed; just play the mission when it appears on the map.
steps: Play Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 to the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. It pops when the mission ends, like every other story trophy.
steps: Play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 to the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. Unmissable — it comes with the story.
steps: Play Child's Play in Chapter 4 to the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. Unmissable — it comes with the story.
steps: Play Headliners in Chapter 4 to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission. Unmissable — it comes with the story.
steps: Play VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. Unmissable — it comes with the story.
steps: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 to the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the checklist at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The checklist only appears after the story, but work done earlier still counts, and nothing on it is missable. It needs, in full: all robberies (8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations), the underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. The rest is a share of each total: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. This is the hardest trophy and the last gate before the Platinum.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear every full requirement first (vaults, operations, shooting golds, drone races, Target Decks).
Top up the shared totals: 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 15 meditations, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 optional missions.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in any mix — stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. There are 397 in Leonida (130 jumps, 202 under-bridge, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps), and flying under bridges is the fastest way to add to the count. Check Progress > Activities > Stunts for your total, and keep going to 300: A Long Road needs 300.
steps: Fly under bridges and hit stunt jumps as you travel — they add up without a separate grind.
Watch the count at Progress > Activities > Stunts.
Keep going to 300 stunts for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress > Activities shows what is left; most of these come naturally while you play.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 types you have not tried.
Try each missing one once — a single attempt is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges (two shooting ranges hold them between them). Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so do them before you chase that one.
steps: Visit both shooting ranges and work through their challenges.
Replay any challenge until you hit gold — 42 golds in total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location's races while you are there instead of coming back.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location and win at least one race there.
Repeat at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 available around Leonida. Re-winning the same race does not count, so keep picking races you have not won yet.
steps: Enter races you have not won before.
Win 20 different ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge. Do it in Chapter 1 while it is in front of you — it stays available later, but the quests start here.
steps: Meet Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1).
Follow his texts to the marked fishing spot.
Play his fishing quests and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game to the end. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the shortest one and play it through.
steps: Pick an arcade game (the TV at home has three).
Play it to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only. Andy's quests start in Chapter 3, when he texts Lucia an address in Belville. Do all five in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one pops the trophy. The strand stays available after the story.
steps: Wait for Andy's text in Chapter 3 (Lucia).
Do his five missions in order.
Finish Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and dig with the metal detector. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
steps: Meet Kenton in Chapter 1 and take the treasure job.
Dive at the purple chest markers and dig up all 7 wrecks.
Finish his final mission when he texts again.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, pops the trophy. The strand stays available after the story.
steps: Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break (Chapter 2).
Do Billy's five jobs in order.
Finish Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not, because they have their own trophies or do not qualify. The remaining qualifying strands were still being confirmed at launch, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. TIME-SENSITIVE: do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it carries an hourglass icon and the strand counts toward this trophy. None of these strands are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.
steps: Do stranger strands as they appear (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete are confirmed).
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3.
Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand; finish 8 qualifying ones.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds. Cars in better condition pay more.
steps: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK and match them to Randy's list.
Deliver all 16 to his garage in west Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) pops the trophy.
steps: Finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 (Jason).
Destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs.
Complete Shut Down the Labs.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Potentially missable: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE — do this in Chapter 1: the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — the morning after Down to Earth: follow Lucia to the balcony and accept her meditation.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), meditate at spots with both characters together — each counts twice.
Work through all 18 spots; the last one needs both characters.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy was not confirmed at launch; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so work through them all.
steps: Wait for Bret's text after Coffee Break (Chapter 2, Jason).
Start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so chase the three nearest to done first.
steps: Open Progress > Collections to see each card set's progress.
Finish any 3 complete sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and the trophy comes with the exploration.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on the phone.
Scan spots as you pass them — 100 of any kind count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way — check the list late in the run and mop up the easy ones.
steps: Play normally — most challenges fill in on their own.
Open Progress > Challenges and finish the easy ones left.
Reach 50; keep going to 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), build a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often pops there.
steps: Call your partner in.
Build a 4-star Wanted Level.
Escape until you are out of the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted (flashing red and blue) — if the stars fade, the chain breaks. Go in with body armour, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewellery stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
steps: Bring your partner and gear up (armour, sticky bombs, healing).
Rob a shop, then two more in a row without losing the Wanted Level.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. Stand beside a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway on the way to A Long Road.
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan vehicles as they pass.
Reach 100 different vehicles; keep going to 200 for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first — eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer — and use an assault rifle. Gang-operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
steps: Fill your Focus meter first (eat, drink or wash up at home).
Find a group of gang-operation thugs.
Trigger Combat Focus while aiming and take down 5 of them before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. Save first, because the police come fast.
steps: Save first, then get into VCIA.
Take a jet docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 or E4).
Back out, take off and fly about 1 km away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank (a Rhino) from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks sit at the south end of the base — and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Save first and expect a heavy military response.
steps: Save first.
Get to Mile Zero Air Station, south end of the base.
Climb into a Rhino and take out enemies from inside it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 gives you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewellery store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3).
Snap open a store's locked back door.
Find the safe code note, empty the safe and leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, each paying up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
steps: Do That's Where The Money Is… (optional, Chapter 4).
Tail a security van to its bank and enter the vault while it is open.
Hand a bag to your partner, then escape the 4-star heat.
Repeat for 5 vaults (8 for 100%).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Robbing a bank vault counts too, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults open, box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
steps: Box in an armored truck (or rob a bank vault).
Blow the back doors with a sticky bomb and take the cash.
Escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed.
steps: Get a plane.
Fly over every dark patch of the map until the fog is gone.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops along the way if you clear them all.
steps: Find illegal operations (yellow icons) on the map.
Rob one belonging to each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — both launch-week guides list this one as unconfirmed. The description points to having a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City, so that is the place to try first. Do not trust an unverified method: if a video or post claims exact steps, check it against a second source before you spend time on it.
steps: Go to a spot with a view on Ocean Beach, Vice City.
Have a cocktail there.
Method unconfirmed at launch — treat any claimed steps as unverified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — both launch-week guides list this one as unconfirmed. The description points to crashing a car out through a vehicle showroom window, in the style of the classic showroom smash. The exact steps were not confirmed when this guide was written.
steps: Try driving a car out through a vehicle showroom window.
Method unconfirmed at launch — treat any claimed steps as unverified.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so take them all if you can.
steps: Take Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 and bring Sticky Bombs.
Take the watch (southeast office), the shotgun (northeast table) and the safe contents (northeast hallway).
Lose the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.
steps: Find a fitness club on the map.
Train with your partner along until both reach maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.
Play normally — robberies and fights feed the count.
Reach 500 profile-changing actions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — both launch-week guides list this one as unconfirmed. The description ('Second time's the charm') suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. No guide had pinned it down when this guide was written.
steps: Method unconfirmed at launch — treat any claimed steps as unverified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — both launch-week guides list this one as unconfirmed. The description suggests a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. Nothing verified yet; it may pop while you play normally.
steps: Method unconfirmed at launch — treat any claimed steps as unverified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — both launch-week guides list this one as unconfirmed. The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by). The exact trigger was not confirmed when this guide was written.
steps: Try melee attacks from a moving vehicle.
Method unconfirmed at launch — treat any claimed steps as unverified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.
steps: Get the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check (Chapter 3).
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Sell them to your contacts until the total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, so buy what you actually want and the total takes care of itself.
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across shops.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to reach it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Buy them early: you need the space for On the Spot registrations.
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garages on offer (about $160,000).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app from Moses' Chapter 2 mission.
Take a stolen vehicle to his garage in Port Gellhorn.
Respray and register it; repeat for 10 vehicles.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Before you start & Chapters 1–2
roadmap.text: Set up for one playthrough: 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, no mission replay, no New Game Plus. Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission. Turn on every progress and collectible notification in Settings, and never use cheats on your trophy save — they switch off trophies and saving. In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth (it feeds Positive Mental Attitude and is gone after Chapter 1), meet Cal in Feng Shui and start his fishing, and finish an arcade game. In Chapter 2, rob Kingpin Bowling (Let's Go Bowling), start Billy at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break, and buy garages once Daily Driver unlocks the Real Estate app.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Chapters 3–4: partner robberies
roadmap.text: Once Jason and Lucia are together, the partner trophies open up: Hot Together (lose a 4-star heat together) and Retail Therapy (three shops back-to-back, still wanted). In Chapter 3, do Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun (Sneakthief), do Race Against Yago the moment it appears (hourglass icon — it counts toward Strangers & Freaks), and get the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check for marked bills. In Chapter 4, do the optional That's Where The Money Is… to open bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal, 5 of 8; all 8 for 100%).

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Finale & side-story finales
roadmap.text: Finish the story (keep that untouched save before the final mission). After the credits, free roam stays open: finish the six side-story finales — Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton (7 shipwrecks), Billy (5 jobs), Randy (16 sports cars), Tyrone (Jason-only, labs) and Bret (Target Decks) — and the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. None of these are needed for 100%, and none are missable after the story.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Free-roam grind
roadmap.text: Clear the long counters while you travel: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), 42 Shooting Range golds, 14 drone-race locations, 20 different race wins, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles scanned, 3 card sets, 50 challenges, the 9 gangs' operations, the jet at VCIA gates E3/E4, the Rhino at Mile Zero, 5 kills in one Combat Focus, and both characters to maximum Strength. Scan vehicles and WAiNK spots as you go — both feed 100%.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 — 100% & the Platinum
roadmap.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through what is left: all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations, the underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold, all drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks, 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. A Long Road (Gold) pops at 100% — and with it, Vice Got a Price!, the Platinum. Around 200 hours in total, most of it on this stage.

notes: All 55 trophies are single-player; there are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals. Cheats switch off trophies and saving. Five trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — this guide says so plainly instead of inventing one. Fair Game's exact triggering animal was also unconfirmed at launch. Sources checked 19 November 2026.
